boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's os_thread.c, 0x02057e34..0x02058568: 18 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/OS_thread.c is a later revision of the file; seventeen of its functions are here, each identified by body, in its source order: OSi_GetUnusedThreadId, OSi_InsertThreadToList, OSi_RemoveThreadFromList, OS_InitThread, OS_CreateThread, OS_ExitThread, OS_JoinThread, OS_IsThreadTerminated, OS_SleepThread, OS_WakeupThread, OS_WakeupThreadDirect, OS_SelectThread, OS_RescheduleThread, OS_SetThreadPriority, OS_GetThreadPriority, OS_SetSwitchThreadCallback, OSi_IdleThreadProc. At pret's sizes: OSi_InsertThreadToList 0x68, OSi_RemoveThreadFromList 0x48, OS_CreateThread 0x108, OS_JoinThread 0x3c, OS_IsThreadTerminated 0x14, OS_WakeupThreadDirect 0x34, OS_SelectThread 0x2c, OS_SetThreadPriority 0xb4, OS_GetThreadPriority 0x8, OS_SetSwitchThreadCallback 0x34, OSi_IdleThreadProc 0x14. The eighteenth, OS_SetThreadStackWarningOffset (0x1c), writes the SDK's stack warning word 0x597dfbd9 at stackTop + stackWarningOffset; pret's revision does not keep it.

Order: all eighteen are C, and mwccarm emits deferred C bodies in reverse. The ROM run is pret's source order reversed (OSi_IdleThreadProc lowest, OSi_GetUnusedThreadId highest), with OS_SetThreadStackWarningOffset between OS_RescheduleThread and OS_SetThreadPriority, and with the functions this revision lacks or this game never calls absent (OS_IsThreadAvailable, OS_DestroyThread, OS_YieldThread, OS_Sleep, the scheduler lock, the destructor and the queue-link helpers).

This is an older revision than pret's: a thread queue is a 16-bit mask of thread ids, OSThreadInfo keeps a 16-entry id table (max_entry, entry[] at +0x14) that OSi_GetUnusedThreadId scans, OS_ExitThread clears the thread's slot, and OS_RescheduleThread carries the scheduler body with no interrupts-off wrapper.

BOTTOM EDGE: func_02057e30 (0x02057e30..0x02057e34) is an empty function whose only reference is the data word 0x0209a03c, beside the OS_IRQTable entries; below it, 0x02057410..0x02057e30 is the Nitro SDK's os_printf.c (arm9/OS_Printf).
TOP EDGE: OS_InitContext (0x02058568..0x020585cc), which pret keeps in OS_context.c with OS_SaveContext and OS_LoadContext; here those two follow it at 0x020585cc and 0x02058618.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/MI_Memory, arm9/OS_SpinLock, arm9/CTRDG_Common and arm9/CARD_Common: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
Sixteen symbols were renamed from their func_ names to the SDK names in this change (symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence); OS_WakeupThread and OS_SleepThread already carried theirs.

Text-only: OSi_ThreadInfo, OSi_CurrentThreadPtr, OSi_IsThreadInitialized, OSi_SystemCallbackInSwitchThread, the launcher and idle threads (OSi_LauncherThread, OSi_IdleThread) and OSi_IdleThreadStack stay externs. The file claims no data.
pret's static helpers (OSi_GetUnusedThreadId, OSi_InsertThreadToList, OSi_RemoveThreadFromList, OSi_IdleThreadProc) keep external linkage here like every other arm9 symbol.
